why: Broken Object Level Authorization: in vulnerable mode GET /books/v1/{book_title} returns any user's book and its secret, though only the owner should see it (README, List of Vulnerabilities; api_views/books.py get_by_title). https://github.com/erev0s/VAmPI#list-of-vulnerabilities

Mass Assignment: POST /users/v1/register takes an `admin` field and makes whoever signs up an admin (README, List of Vulnerabilities; api_views/users.py register_user). https://github.com/erev0s/VAmPI#list-of-vulnerabilities
VAmPI documents no book delete (openapi3.yml has only get_all_books, add_new_book and get_by_title under /books/v1), so the books a run adds stay behind.

openapi3.yml declares the 200 of GET /books/v1/{book_title} as {type: array, items: {book_title, owner, secret}}, but VAmPI answers the one book as an object ("(root) must be array"). https://github.com/erev0s/VAmPI openapi_specs/openapi3.yml
